_comment: An undeclared vendored bootstrap.min.css is a third-party CSS library and must be flagged by missing-library, exactly like a bundled .min.js would be (classifyBundled must hash CSS files too, not only JS). The classifier hashes it and the library hash DB names it bootstrap 5.3.0, so missing-library reports it. --checks-only isolates the finding so the golden tracks only the CSS detection.
